title: Matte Black Wall Mounted Soap Dish - 4.5 In Solid Brass Bathroom Soap Dish, Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear your bathroom countertop and keep bar soap within easy reach—backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty — available in Matte Black, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs. This wall mounted soap dish adds a finished look while saving space at the sink.

  • Matte Black makes a bold, modern statement
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Concealed screw mounting delivers a clean, built-in look
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Coordinate a unified bathroom with matching Dottingham pieces

Specs

  • Product type: Wall mounted soap dish / bathroom soap holder
  • Material: Brass (solid brass)
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 4.5 in x 3 in x 3.5 in
  • Projection: 5 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 1.6 lb
  • Included: Brass soap dish holder and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Part of the Dottingham collection—complete your bathroom with matching accessories for a coordinated look.
meta_description: Wall mounted soap dish with solid brass construction, 4.5 in length and concealed screw mount. Includes hardware and a Limited Lifetime Warranty.
